description: This file defines the LogConsistencyProvider class, which implements a log consistency provider for Orleans that interacts with storage providers to store the latest view and metadata, supporting multiple clusters with optimistic concurrency.

classes.name: LogConsistencyProvider
classes.description: Implements a log consistency provider that manages the latest view and metadata storage, supporting multi-cluster setups with optimistic concurrency control.

methods.name: MakeLogViewAdaptor
methods.description: Creates an instance of LogViewAdaptor for a specified view and log entry type, facilitating log consistency operations.
